title: AI hedge fund Situational Awareness may have sold its public portfolio, but it still has its Anthropic shares
summary: Situational Awareness, a hedge fund formed by former OpenAI researcher Leopold Aschenbrenner, has sold the majority of its public stock portfolio to Ken Griffin’s Citadel following steep losses over the past month, The Wall Street Journal reported earlier on Thursday.
